entries.name: Exa
entries.caveat: Same Exa API as the shared MCP. Own key changes the quota; it does not remove the secret requirement.

entries.name: Obsidian (Local REST API harness)
entries.caveat: Cloud agents already read this vault from git. The harness only helps a running desktop Obsidian.

entries.name: Official Obsidian CLI
entries.caveat: Prefer the official bundled CLI over the third-party harness when the desktop app is present.

entries.name: n8n
entries.caveat: Useful only if an n8n instance is already in play. Not a substitute for messaging or paid-media MCPs.

entries.name: Mailchimp
entries.caveat: Account API. Sending mail is Tier 2.

entries.name: VE Twini
entries.caveat: GraphQL plus browser automation. Do not install. High prompt-injection and account-takeover risk.

entries.name: Browser CDP
entries.caveat: Overlaps the existing Claude-in-Chrome / 64GB CDP lane. Desktop only.

blockers.summary: GitHub MCP authentication or discovery failed
blockers.next: Use `gh`. Do not add another GitHub MCP.

blockers.summary: A connected MCP loaded more tools than the task needs
blockers.next: Call the official CLI or one catalog command instead of enabling the full toolset.
Need operator-supplied EXA_API_KEY. Then `cli-hub install exa` or curl the Exa API. Shared MCP quota stays exhausted either way.

blockers.summary: mohr-vault Obsidian MCP dead (bad path, placeholder key)
blockers.next: Keep using git + 12_Brain. Do not resurrect mohr-vault. Desktop Local REST API is optional and operator-only.

blockers.summary: LandingFolio MCP sandbox-only until Inspector + token
blockers.next: No catalog CLI. Operator mints LANDINGFOLIO_TOKEN and runs node _os/automation/bin/landingfolio-verify.js.

blockers.summary: Slack OAuth rejected or Composio write block
blockers.next: No Slack row in CLI-Hub. Reauth is an operator action. Writes stay Tier 2.

blockers.summary: Google Ads, GA4, Meta, or Search Console MCP not connected
blockers.next: No catalog CLIs. Keep JSON exports / Chrome-on-64GB. Do not invent counts.
No catalog CLI. Token is an operator secret.

blockers.summary: X MCP failed live tool discovery
blockers.next: Do not install VE Twini. Use WebSearch/WebFetch or wait for X MCP to recover.
